newsitem.title: USA: Mystery surrounds whereabouts of Cunanan remains.
newsitem.headline: Mystery surrounds whereabouts of Cunanan remains.

text.p: The final resting place of the suspected spree killer believed to have murdered fashion designer Gianni Versace remained a mystery on Monday.

In death as in life, Andrew Cunanan was elusive. No information was available from his family, reportedly in hiding in the San Diego area, and a worker at a suburban church declined to confirm or deny that a memorial service had been quietly held there during the day.

A funeral home also in the San Diego suburb of Bonita said it had arranged for Cunanan's body to be cremated. But it denied receiving his ashes or planning a funeral for the man who until last week topped the FBI's Most Wanted List.

Glenn Abbey Memorial Park said it had arranged for a Miami funeral home to cremate Cunanan's body after he committed suicide last Wednesday while an army of police was searching for him in south Florida and across the country.

"We are assisting the Cunanan family as a liaison with the funeral home in Florida to arrange for his cremation. There are no services or burials scheduled at Glenn Abbey," the funeral home said in a statement.
An employee at the funeral home said it had not yet received the ashes and added that there had been a memorial service at St. Rita's Church.
But a church employee could not confirm that, and church officials were not available for comment.
Cunanan's body was released to a Miami funeral home on Saturday, three days after he shot himself on being discovered on a houseboat.
"The family asked that we keep things as quiet as possible," a spokesman for the Miami funeral home told Reuters.
Cunanan is accused of gunning down Versace on the steps of the designer's oceanfront mansion on July 15. He is also suspected in the killing of four other men.
Police found Cunanan's body on Wednesday after storming a houseboat about two miles (3.2 km) north of Versace's home.
The medical examiner's office would say only that Cunanan died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

They would not say whether he was already dead when police stormed the houseboat or whether he carried the HIV virus. There have been reports that Cunanan's alleged killing spree was triggered by the discovery that he carried the virus that causes AIDS.
